For every positive finite cavity length q, the least complete outward-return period is 2q cells. Every generated positive mode n has exact period 2qn, so distinct supported modes form a discrete positive whole-indexed family. Appending one path cell changes the round trip from 2q to 2(q+1) while preserving bounded recurrence.
